Uh, yes, we'll be arriving by car about 10 o'clock Friday night.
呃，是的，我们周五晚上十点左右开车到。

101
00:04:02,848 --> 00:04:03,287
Stewart.
斯图尔特。

102
00:04:04,568 --> 00:04:06,447
S-T-E-W-A-R-T.
S-T-E-W-A-R-T。

103
00:04:08,168 --> 00:04:08,568
Thank you.
谢谢。

104
00:04:10,808 --> 00:04:11,168
Done.
好了。

105
00:04:13,248 --> 00:04:14,117
You and I, Mrs.
我和您，

106
00:04:14,197 --> 00:04:17,487
Stewart, are going to have a wonderful romantic weekend.
斯图尔特夫人，将度过一个美好的浪漫周末。

107
00:04:20,528 --> 00:04:21,687
Richard, that's a baby.
理查德，那是个婴儿。
44:
1
00:00:00,200 --> 00:00:00,880
Right this way, Mr.
这边请，

2
00:00:00,900 --> 00:00:01,159
and Mrs.
斯图尔特

3
00:00:01,200 --> 00:00:01,560
Stewart.
先生和夫人。

4
00:00:11,160 --> 00:00:12,679
Well, it's small, but clean.
嗯，房间虽小，但很干净。

5
00:00:14,160 --> 00:00:14,519
Clean?
干净？

6
00:00:15,520 --> 00:00:16,559
You call this clean?
你管这叫干净？

7
00:00:21,960 --> 00:00:22,679
Have a nice day.
祝您愉快。

8
00:00:24,000 --> 00:00:24,479
Thank you.
谢谢。

9
00:00:26,960 --> 00:00:28,040
I don't believe this.
我真不敢相信。

10
00:00:33,432 --> 00:00:37,631
Well, it isn't, uh, the Watermill Inn,
好吧，这里虽然不是“水磨坊旅馆”，

11
00:00:39,832 --> 00:00:42,272
but, uh, let's get a look at the view.
不过，我们来看看外面的景色吧。

12
00:00:52,552 --> 00:00:53,464
How is the view?
景色怎么样？

13
00:00:54,585 --> 00:00:54,984
Great.
棒极了。

14
00:00:56,145 --> 00:00:57,905
If you enjoy looking at a parking lot.
如果你喜欢看停车场的话。

15
00:00:59,625 --> 00:01:03,264
Well, maybe we'll see the view in the morning.
也许早上能看到好景色。

16
00:01:04,025 --> 00:01:05,824
Right now, we should clean up this room.
现在，我们应该先把房间收拾一下。

17
00:01:22,457 --> 00:01:23,217
Sorry, Marilyn.
对不起，玛丽莲。

18
00:01:24,497 --> 00:01:25,776
How should you be sorry?
你为什么要道歉？

19
00:01:26,817 --> 00:01:30,937
Oh, the rain, the room, the view of the parking lot.
唉，又是下雨，又是这房间，还有那停车场的景色。

20
00:01:32,337 --> 00:01:34,117
It isn't the way I hoped it would be.
这不是我期望的样子。

21
00:01:35,497 --> 00:01:37,017
Stop blaming yourself.
别自责了。

22
00:01:38,617 --> 00:01:42,409
After all, we're, we're here, we're alone,
毕竟，我们在这里，只有我们两个人，

23
00:01:43,850 --> 00:01:46,669
we're together, and I love you.
我们在一起，而且我爱你。

24
00:01:48,690 --> 00:01:49,529
Isn't that enough?
这还不够吗？

25
00:01:50,490 --> 00:01:53,650
It is for me, but I wanted this weekend to be special for you.
对我来说够了，但我希望这个周末对你来说特别一些。

26
00:01:56,050 --> 00:01:56,889
It is special.
它已经很特别了。

27
00:01:58,890 --> 00:01:59,889
Happy anniversary.
周年快乐。

28
00:02:06,130 --> 00:02:07,130
It's still raining.
还在下雨。

29
00:02:07,562 --> 00:02:08,561
I want to play tennis.
我想打网球。

30
00:02:09,722 --> 00:02:10,882
I want some breakfast.
我想吃早餐。

31
00:02:11,522 --> 00:02:13,921
Let's call room service or order a nice breakfast,
我们叫客房服务，或者点一份丰盛的早餐，

32
00:02:14,482 --> 00:02:15,961
and then we'll figure out what to do today.
然后再决定今天做什么。

33
00:02:17,042 --> 00:02:17,401
Right.
好的。

34
00:02:21,762 --> 00:02:23,122
Would you get me room service, please?
请给我送客房服务好吗？

35
00:02:25,682 --> 00:02:26,561
I beg your pardon.
抱歉，我没听清。

36
00:02:30,302 --> 00:02:31,121
Oh, I see.
哦，我明白了。

37
00:02:35,275 --> 00:02:37,755
They don't have room service at Old Country Inn.
“老乡村旅馆”没有客房服务。

38
00:02:39,635 --> 00:02:42,035
Well, let's go down to the coffee shop.
那我们去咖啡馆吧。

39
00:02:43,515 --> 00:02:44,875
They don't have a coffee shop.
他们也没有咖啡馆。

40
00:02:45,995 --> 00:02:47,374
We can get our meals at Mrs.
我们可以去街对面的

41
00:02:47,515 --> 00:02:48,995
Montefiore's down the road.
蒙特菲奥里太太家吃饭。

42
00:02:52,315 --> 00:02:53,314
Well, that's okay, honey.
没关系，亲爱的。

43
00:02:53,995 --> 00:02:55,354
I love walking in the rain.
我喜欢在雨中散步。

44
00:02:55,635 --> 00:02:58,946
Oh, you're being a really good sport about this,
哦，你对此真的很随和，

45
00:02:59,026 --> 00:03:00,947
Marilyn, but I think we should face the truth.
玛丽莲，但我觉得我们应该面对现实。

46
00:03:01,227 --> 00:03:01,747
What's that?
什么现实？

47
00:03:02,907 --> 00:03:05,346
This is not the way to spend our fifth anniversary.
这不是庆祝我们五周年纪念的方式。

48
00:03:05,987 --> 00:03:07,907
Well, what do you want to do?
那你想怎么做？

49
00:03:09,987 --> 00:03:11,666
Why don't we get in the car and drive home?
我们上车回家怎么样？

50
00:03:12,467 --> 00:03:14,346
Oh, Richard, it really isn't that bad.
哦，理查德，其实没那么糟。

51
00:03:15,747 --> 00:03:18,419
Do you want to stick it out for the whole weekend?
你想坚持整个周末吗？

52
00:03:20,900 --> 00:03:23,180
Well, I'll admit the room is uncomfortable.
嗯，我承认这房间很不舒服。

53
00:03:23,580 --> 00:03:24,059
Mm-hmm.
嗯哼。

54
00:03:25,660 --> 00:03:29,459
And I do feel bad about your mother having to take care of the baby all weekend.
而且我也很抱歉你母亲整个周末都得照顾宝宝。

55
00:03:31,020 --> 00:03:32,180
Why don't we just check out?
我们干脆退房吧？

56
00:03:32,580 --> 00:03:32,939
Okay.
好吧。

57
00:03:40,580 --> 00:03:41,019
Hello?
喂？

58
00:03:41,900 --> 00:03:42,260
Yes?
哪位？

59
00:03:43,060 --> 00:03:43,939
Yes, this is she.
是的，我就是。

60
00:03:45,213 --> 00:03:46,133
Oh, hello.
哦，你好。

61
00:03:47,133 --> 00:03:48,773
How nice of you to remember us.
你还记得我们，真好。

62
00:03:50,213 --> 00:03:51,453
Yes, my husband did call.
是的，我丈夫打过电话了。

63
00:03:53,213 --> 00:03:53,732
You do?
是吗？

64
00:03:55,213 --> 00:03:55,652
Really?
真的吗？

65
00:03:57,173 --> 00:03:58,613
It w- it won't be any trouble?
这……不会太麻烦吧？

66
00:04:00,253 --> 00:04:00,892
Oh, yes.
哦，不麻烦。

67
00:04:01,733 --> 00:04:03,212
I think we'd like that very much.
我想我们会非常乐意接受的。

68
00:04:05,853 --> 00:04:06,733
15 minutes.
十五分钟。

69
00:04:08,453 --> 00:04:09,093
Thank you.
谢谢。

70
00:04:10,005 --> 00:04:10,604
Goodbye.
再见。

71
00:04:14,845 --> 00:04:16,005
You will never guess.
你绝对猜不到。

72
00:04:17,245 --> 00:04:19,045
Uh, I give up.
呃，我猜不出来。

73
00:04:20,165 --> 00:04:20,525
Mrs.
蒙特菲奥

74
00:04:21,165 --> 00:04:23,964
Montefiore from the Watermill Inn.
里夫人，来自水磨旅馆。

75
00:04:25,525 --> 00:04:26,844
What is she calling about?
她打电话来有什么事？

76
00:04:28,245 --> 00:04:29,324
They have an opening.
他们有空房了。

77
00:04:29,965 --> 00:04:31,605
Someone just checked out, and Mrs.
刚有人退房，蒙特菲奥

78
00:04:31,685 --> 00:04:34,077
Montefiore has reserved the honeymoon suite
里夫人已经为我们预订了蜜月套房

79
00:04:34,478 --> 00:04:35,117
for us.
。

80
00:04:35,638 --> 00:04:36,157
You're kidding.
你在开玩笑吧。

81
00:04:36,358 --> 00:04:36,658
No.
没有。

82
00:04:37,758 --> 00:04:38,637
Isn't it wonderful?
是不是很棒？

83
00:04:38,838 --> 00:04:39,998
It's fantastic!
太棒了！

84
00:04:40,798 --> 00:04:41,237
Oh!
哦！

85
00:04:42,038 --> 00:04:43,677
Now all it has to do is stop raining.
现在只要雨停就好了。

86
00:04:45,078 --> 00:04:45,878
Let's go.
走吧。
45:
1
00:00:07,680 --> 00:00:09,240
Welcome to the Watermill Inn.
欢迎来到水磨坊旅馆。

2
00:00:10,200 --> 00:00:13,359
Oh, Richard, it's exactly as it was when we were married.
哦，理查德，这里和我们结婚时一模一样。

3
00:00:13,800 --> 00:00:15,319
And when I got married.
和我结婚时也一样。

4
00:00:16,160 --> 00:00:18,480
Even the old patchwork quilt is the same.
连那床旧拼布被都没变。

5
00:00:19,200 --> 00:00:23,440
My great-grandmother made that quilt when Teddy Roosevelt was president.
我曾祖母在泰迪·罗斯福当总统时做了这床被子。

6
00:00:24,360 --> 00:00:26,039
In those days when they made quilts,
那时候做被子，

7
00:00:26,320 --> 00:00:30,497
they cut patches from the old clothing of every member in the family
他们会从家里每个成员的旧衣服上剪下布块，

8
00:00:31,037 --> 00:00:32,917
so that each one would be a part of it.
让每个人都成为其中的一部分。

9
00:00:33,117 --> 00:00:34,396
What a lovely tradition.
多么美好的传统。

10
00:00:34,877 --> 00:00:36,157
Thank you for calling us.
谢谢你们打电话来。

11
00:00:36,837 --> 00:00:39,996
I remember you and your wife from the first time you stayed with us.
我记得你们夫妇俩第一次住在我们这儿的样子。

12
00:00:40,717 --> 00:00:41,637
We were very young.
那时我们很年轻。

13
00:00:42,597 --> 00:00:44,317
And very much in love.
而且非常相爱。

14
00:00:45,037 --> 00:00:46,116
We have a baby now.
我们现在有个宝宝了。

15
00:00:46,797 --> 00:00:48,196
How wonderful.
太好了。

16
00:00:48,597 --> 00:00:49,756
A boy or a girl?
是男孩还是女孩？

17
00:00:50,435 --> 00:00:51,874
A boy, Max.
是个男孩，叫麦克斯。

18
00:00:52,635 --> 00:00:53,635
Do you have a picture?
你有照片吗？

19
00:00:54,395 --> 00:00:56,874
Would a professional photographer be without a picture?
专业摄影师怎么会没有照片呢？

20
00:01:00,355 --> 00:01:03,234
Oh, he's adorable.
哦，他真可爱。

21
00:01:03,555 --> 00:01:04,354
And very bright.
而且很聪明。

22
00:01:04,795 --> 00:01:06,674
Like his father, a real Stuart.
像他父亲一样，真正的斯图尔特家的人。

23
00:01:07,075 --> 00:01:08,594
And very good looking, like his mother.
也很英俊，像他母亲。

24
00:01:09,395 --> 00:01:11,234
Well, it's nice to have you with us again.
嗯，很高兴你们再次光临。

25
00:01:11,715 --> 00:01:13,032
Next time bring the baby.
下次带上宝宝来吧。

26
00:01:13,953 --> 00:01:16,033
You see, Richard, Max is welcome here.
你看，理查德，麦克斯在这里很受欢迎。

27
00:01:16,273 --> 00:01:17,552
Not on our anniversary.
但不在我们的纪念日。

28
00:01:18,033 --> 00:01:19,632
This vacation is for you and me.
这次假期是给你和我的。

29
00:01:20,753 --> 00:01:22,792
If there's anything you need, please call me.
如果有什么需要，请随时叫我。

30
00:01:23,033 --> 00:01:24,673
I'll be in the front office all day.
我一整天都会在前台办公室。

31
00:01:27,673 --> 00:01:31,113
Oh, I took the liberty of ordering some breakfast for you.
哦，我擅自给你们点了一些早餐。

32
00:01:35,591 --> 00:01:37,030
Just put it over there, Charles.
就放在那边吧，查尔斯。

33
00:01:54,911 --> 00:01:55,870
Thank you, Charles.
谢谢你，查尔斯。

34
00:01:58,109 --> 00:01:59,849
Compliments of the Watermill Inn.
这是水磨坊旅馆的一点心意。

35
00:01:59,989 --> 00:02:00,308
Oh.
哦。

36
00:02:00,629 --> 00:02:01,109
Thank you.
谢谢。

37
00:02:01,429 --> 00:02:02,509
Thank you so much.
非常感谢。

38
00:02:06,549 --> 00:02:08,908
Now this is my idea of a good time.
这才是我心目中的美好时光。

39
00:02:09,989 --> 00:02:10,868
Let's see.
让我看看。

40
00:02:12,149 --> 00:02:16,688
Hot cakes and maple syrup with scrambled
热松饼配枫糖浆和炒

41
00:02:16,829 --> 00:02:17,268
eggs.
蛋。

42
00:02:17,749 --> 00:02:19,389
Mm, smell that coffee.
嗯，闻闻这咖啡的香味。

43
00:02:19,829 --> 00:02:21,227
Cinnamon and cloves.
肉桂和丁香的味道。

44
00:02:21,627 --> 00:02:22,947
Homemade buttermilk biscuits.
自制酪乳饼干。

45
00:02:23,067 --> 00:02:23,367
Mm.
嗯。

46
00:02:24,107 --> 00:02:26,227
Slices of orange with burnt honey.
橙片配焦糖蜂蜜。

47
00:02:27,707 --> 00:02:28,227
Let's eat.
我们吃吧。

48
00:02:29,307 --> 00:02:31,747
First, I want to call home and check on your mother and the baby.
首先，我想打个电话回家，问问你妈妈和宝宝的情况。

49
00:02:32,227 --> 00:02:34,387
Honey, if there were any problems, she would call us.
亲爱的，如果有什么问题，她会给我们打电话的。

50
00:02:35,067 --> 00:02:36,787
She doesn't know we've changed hotels.
她不知道我们换了酒店。

51
00:02:37,227 --> 00:02:38,344
You're right, of course.
你说得对，当然。

52
00:02:47,145 --> 00:02:48,025
Hello, operator.
你好，接线员。

53
00:02:48,945 --> 00:02:51,064
I'd like to call Riverdale, New York.
我想打给纽约的里弗代尔。

54
00:02:57,305 --> 00:02:58,704
This food is heavenly, isn't it?
这食物真是美味极了，不是吗？

55
00:02:59,385 --> 00:02:59,985
Thank you.
谢谢。

56
00:03:00,825 --> 00:03:02,745
This whole place is heavenly.
这整个地方都美妙极了。

57
00:03:11,983 --> 00:03:13,703
Do you remember that old desk?
你还记得那张旧书桌吗？

58
00:03:15,703 --> 00:03:15,983
Mrs.
夫人。

59
00:03:16,063 --> 00:03:18,342
Montefiore told me that George Washington
蒙特菲奥里太太告诉我，乔治·华盛顿

60
00:03:18,463 --> 00:03:21,422
sat at that desk and wrote to his wife Martha.
曾坐在那张书桌前给他的妻子玛莎写信。

61
00:03:22,303 --> 00:03:23,703
What do you want to do after breakfast?
早餐后你想做什么？

62
00:03:25,223 --> 00:03:26,860
Why don't we take a walk down to the river?
我们何不散步到河边去呢？

63
00:03:27,861 --> 00:03:28,540
In the rain?
在雨中吗？

64
00:03:29,261 --> 00:03:29,661
No.
不。

65
00:03:30,261 --> 00:03:31,140
Look out the window.
看看窗外。

66
00:03:31,581 --> 00:03:32,820
The sun is shining.
阳光灿烂。

67
00:03:37,421 --> 00:03:40,340
Now this is my idea of a good time.
这才是我心目中的美好时光。
46:
1
00:00:14,280 --> 00:00:16,260
The mailman just dropped some mail in our box,
邮递员刚往我们信箱里塞了些邮件，

2
00:00:16,320 --> 00:00:16,659
Grandpa.
爷爷。

3
00:00:16,920 --> 00:00:19,679
Oh, probably a lot of advertising and bills.
哦，大概都是些广告和账单吧。

4
00:00:21,120 --> 00:00:24,279
Why don't you write to me, Robbie, so I can get some interesting mail?
罗比，你为什么不给我写信呢？这样我就能收到一些有趣的邮件了。

5
00:00:46,034 --> 00:00:47,193
You were right, Grandpa.
你说得对，爷爷。

6
00:00:48,114 --> 00:00:52,473
Advertising, bills, bills, advertising.
全是广告、账单、账单、广告。

7
00:00:53,874 --> 00:00:55,668
It's just like I said, Robbie.
正如我所说，罗比。

8
00:00:56,708 --> 00:00:57,587
Nothing interesting.
没什么有趣的。

9
00:00:58,188 --> 00:01:01,987
You won't believe it, Grandpa, but there's a letter here addressed to you.
爷爷，你不会相信的，这里有一封寄给你的信。

10
00:01:02,708 --> 00:01:02,948
Mr.
马尔科姆·斯图尔特先生，

11
00:01:03,028 --> 00:01:05,308
Malcolm Stewart, and it looks like a personal letter.
看起来像是私人信件。

12
00:01:05,548 --> 00:01:06,548
That must be a bill.
那肯定是张账单。

13
00:01:07,188 --> 00:01:07,987
I don't think so.
我不这么认为。

14
00:01:08,548 --> 00:01:11,128
The return name and address is Pete Waters,
回信人的姓名和地址是皮特·沃特斯，

15
00:01:11,508 --> 00:01:13,428
RFD number 1, Chesterton.
切斯特顿乡村投递路线1号。

16
00:01:13,788 --> 00:01:14,507
You're joking.
你在开玩笑吧。

17
00:01:15,868 --> 00:01:16,627
Pete Waters?
皮特·沃特斯？

18
00:01:17,668 --> 00:01:20,421
Pete Waters, RFD number 1, Chesterton.
皮特·沃特斯，切斯特顿乡村投递路线1号。

19
00:01:21,302 --> 00:01:21,822
You know him?
你认识他吗？

20
00:01:22,542 --> 00:01:24,101
Do I know Pete Waters?
我认不认识皮特·沃特斯？

21
00:01:24,942 --> 00:01:25,941
You bet I do.
当然认识。

22
00:01:26,822 --> 00:01:28,541
He was my roommate in college.
他是我大学时的室友。

23
00:01:34,222 --> 00:01:37,622
He visited with grandma and me in Florida about 5 years ago.
大约五年前，他和奶奶一起来佛罗里达看望过我。

24
00:01:45,136 --> 00:01:45,935
What does he say?
他说什么了？

25
00:01:46,015 --> 00:01:46,776
Is he okay?
他还好吗？

26
00:01:47,936 --> 00:01:49,615
Yeah, he's fine, just fine.
是的，他很好，非常好。

27
00:01:51,856 --> 00:01:56,455
He's writing to invite me to spend a weekend with him at his farm.
他写信邀请我去他的农场度周末。

28
00:01:57,776 --> 00:02:00,655
He's planning a get-together with two or three other college friends.
他打算和两三个其他大学朋友聚一聚。

29
00:02:02,096 --> 00:02:06,216
A kind of, uh, 50-year anniversary reunion.
算是……呃，五十周年同学聚会吧。

30
00:02:07,056 --> 00:02:08,015
Sounds like fun.
听起来挺有意思的。

31
00:02:08,810 --> 00:02:09,690
50 years?
五十年？

32
00:02:10,370 --> 00:02:10,770
Wow.
哇。

33
00:02:11,330 --> 00:02:13,089
This sounds like fun to me too, Robbie.
罗比，我也觉得这挺有意思的。

34
00:02:14,290 --> 00:02:15,570
What kind of farm does he have?
他经营什么样的农场？

35
00:02:16,490 --> 00:02:17,690
I've never been there, Robbie,
我没去过那里，罗比，

36
00:02:18,690 --> 00:02:21,770
but he has chickens and cows and all.
但他养了鸡、牛之类的动物。

37
00:02:22,850 --> 00:02:25,249
That means fresh eggs and fresh milk.
这意味着有新鲜鸡蛋和新鲜牛奶。

38
00:02:25,810 --> 00:02:26,890
Does he have a family?
他有家人吗？

39
00:02:28,010 --> 00:02:29,129
No, he doesn't, Robbie.
没有，罗比。

40
00:02:29,730 --> 00:02:30,609
He never married.
他从未结过婚。

41
00:02:31,450 --> 00:02:34,744
He's not as lucky as I am to have a family and
他没有像我这么幸运，拥有家庭和

42
00:02:35,244 --> 00:02:36,003
grandchildren.
孙辈。

43
00:02:37,804 --> 00:02:38,803
I'm a lucky man.
我是个幸运的人。

44
00:02:39,684 --> 00:02:41,044
How come he never got married?
他为什么一直没结婚？

45
00:02:42,044 --> 00:02:43,324
That's a good question, Robbie.
这是个好问题，罗比。

46
00:02:44,204 --> 00:02:45,283
A very good question.
非常好的问题。

47
00:02:46,644 --> 00:02:49,383
He never married because the girl he was
他没结婚是因为他在大学时爱上的那个女孩

48
00:02:49,424 --> 00:02:51,604
in love with in college married someone else.
嫁给了别人。

49
00:02:52,124 --> 00:02:53,164
As simple as that.
就这么简单。

50
00:02:54,044 --> 00:02:55,244
He never got over it.
他始终没能释怀。

51
00:02:56,004 --> 00:02:57,798
He must have loved her very much.
他一定非常爱她。

52
00:02:58,198 --> 00:02:59,798
Yes, very much.
是的，非常爱。

53
00:03:01,318 --> 00:03:02,277
Lillian Winters.
莉莲·温特斯。

54
00:03:03,078 --> 00:03:04,118
She was in our class.
她是我们的同学。

55
00:03:04,718 --> 00:03:05,558
And what happened?
后来发生了什么？

56
00:03:06,318 --> 00:03:10,518
She was in love with Donald McGrath, the quarterback on our football team.
她爱上了唐纳德·麦格拉斯，我们橄榄球队的四分卫。

57
00:03:11,398 --> 00:03:14,037
Football players are always popular with the ladies.
橄榄球运动员总是很受女士们欢迎。

58
00:03:14,278 --> 00:03:14,578
Yeah.
是啊。

59
00:03:15,278 --> 00:03:18,198
She liked Pete, and they went to dances together,
她喜欢皮特，他们一起参加过舞会，

60
00:03:19,158 --> 00:03:20,917
but her heart was with Donald.
但她的心在唐纳德那里。

61
00:03:21,638 --> 00:03:22,872
Did he ever get over it?
他后来走出来了吗？

62
00:03:23,832 --> 00:03:24,751
No, he never did.
没有，他从未走出来过。

63
00:03:25,352 --> 00:03:26,352
Where is she today?
她现在在哪里？

64
00:03:27,672 --> 00:03:28,352
I don't know.
我不知道。

65
00:03:29,952 --> 00:03:31,832
Maybe Lillian will be at the reunion.
也许莉莲会来参加聚会。

66
00:03:32,392 --> 00:03:33,112
You think so?
你觉得呢？

67
00:03:33,872 --> 00:03:35,191
Pete's full of surprises.
皮特总是出人意料。

68
00:03:35,712 --> 00:03:37,472
I wish I could go there with you, Grandpa.
我真希望能和你一起去，爷爷。

69
00:03:38,152 --> 00:03:39,672
What do you think the surprise will be?
你觉得会有什么惊喜？

70
00:03:41,472 --> 00:03:43,511
With Pete, you never know, Robbie.
跟皮特有关的事，你永远猜不到，罗比。

71
00:03:44,352 --> 00:03:47,546
Won't it be exciting to see all your college friends there again?
再次见到所有大学朋友不是很令人兴奋吗？

72
00:03:48,506 --> 00:03:49,385
It is already.
已经让人兴奋了。

73
00:03:50,786 --> 00:03:52,906
I'm kind of excited about going now.
我现在对去那儿有点兴奋了。

74
00:03:56,266 --> 00:04:00,346
Next weekend, sleep over Friday and Saturday night
下周末，周五和周六晚上住在那儿，

75
00:04:01,066 --> 00:04:02,426
and come back Sunday.
周日回来。

76
00:04:04,186 --> 00:04:04,946
I can't wait.
我迫不及待了。

77
00:04:07,826 --> 00:04:10,266
Don't you think you ought to call Pete and tell him you're coming?
你不觉得应该给皮特打个电话，告诉他你要来吗？

78
00:04:10,746 --> 00:04:12,185
You're reading my mind, Robbie.
你正合我意，罗比。
47:
1
00:00:22,720 --> 00:00:24,180
Hello, what can I do for you?
你好，有什么可以帮您的？

2
00:00:24,320 --> 00:00:25,880
Hi, fill her up.
嗨，给她加满油。

3
00:00:26,120 --> 00:00:27,080
I need a full tank.
我要加满油箱。

4
00:00:27,560 --> 00:00:28,210
Check the hood?
要检查引擎盖吗？

5
00:00:28,730 --> 00:00:29,250
No, thanks.
不用了，谢谢。

6
00:00:38,490 --> 00:00:39,450
Where abouts you headed?
您要去哪儿？

7
00:00:40,090 --> 00:00:41,370
Uh, Pete Waters' farm.
呃，皮特·沃特斯的农场。

8
00:00:41,530 --> 00:00:41,830
Ah.
啊。

9
00:00:42,010 --> 00:00:42,849
Near Chesterton.
在切斯特顿附近。

10
00:00:43,450 --> 00:00:44,210
I know it well.
我对那儿很熟。

11
00:00:44,490 --> 00:00:44,790
Huh?
嗯？

12
00:00:45,010 --> 00:00:47,730
Oh, Pete Waters lived around here almost as long as I have.
哦，皮特·沃特斯住在这片儿的时间跟我差不多长。

13
00:00:49,170 --> 00:00:51,379
How long is it going to take to for me to get there?
我到那儿大概需要多久？

14
00:00:51,780 --> 00:00:52,940
About 15 minutes.
大约15分钟。

15
00:00:53,540 --> 00:00:54,980
There's a shortcut, if you know it.
有条近路，如果你知道的话。

16
00:00:56,020 --> 00:00:56,579
I don't.
我不知道。

17
00:00:57,820 --> 00:00:59,979
Could you, uh, tell me how to use the shortcut?
你能，呃，告诉我怎么走那条近路吗？

18
00:01:00,260 --> 00:01:00,580
Sure.
当然。

19
00:01:01,020 --> 00:01:02,419
You take the next left turn.
下一个路口左转。

20
00:01:02,980 --> 00:01:04,380
You'll see a stop sign.
你会看到一个停车标志。

21
00:01:05,340 --> 00:01:06,820
Make a right at the stop sign.
在停车标志处右转。

22
00:01:07,580 --> 00:01:10,500
Stay on that road and you'll cross a blue bridge.
沿着那条路走，你会经过一座蓝色的桥。

23
00:01:11,020 --> 00:01:13,079
Then you'll see a big old red barn.
然后你会看到一座很大的旧红色谷仓。

24
00:01:13,580 --> 00:01:15,269
That's the back of Pete Water's place.
那就是皮特·沃特斯家的后面。

25
00:01:15,750 --> 00:01:16,109
Huh.
嗯。

26
00:01:17,550 --> 00:01:20,709
That's quite a difference from the directions that Pete sent me.
这跟皮特发给我的路线差别挺大。

27
00:01:21,630 --> 00:01:22,030
Oh yeah?
是吗？

28
00:01:23,190 --> 00:01:25,970
Now, if you take that route, it's probably a lot simpler,
要是你走那条路，可能简单得多，

29
00:01:26,030 --> 00:01:27,910
but, uh, take you 10 minutes longer.
但是，呃，要多花10分钟。

30
00:01:29,070 --> 00:01:29,510
Ah.
啊。

31
00:01:30,870 --> 00:01:31,470
Okay.
好吧。

32
00:01:32,950 --> 00:01:33,789
Let me repeat it.
让我复述一遍。

33
00:01:34,270 --> 00:01:34,649
Uh-huh.
嗯哼。

34
00:01:34,790 --> 00:01:38,000
Uh, take the next left turn to the stop sign,
呃，到停车标志处下一个路口左转，

35
00:01:38,920 --> 00:01:42,220
then a right across a blue bridge.
然后右转过一座蓝色的桥。

36
00:01:42,440 --> 00:01:42,759
Uh-huh.
嗯哼。

37
00:01:43,360 --> 00:01:45,479
And then a big red barn.
然后是一座红色的大谷仓。

38
00:01:45,960 --> 00:01:46,640
Can't miss it.
不会错过的。

39
00:01:50,520 --> 00:01:51,439
How much do I owe you?
我该付多少钱？

40
00:01:51,960 --> 00:01:56,159
Well, that'll be 18 dollars and 70 cents.
嗯，一共是18美元70美分。

41
00:01:56,600 --> 00:01:59,040
Uh, no charge for the cleanup, it's on the house.
呃，清理费不收费，算我们请的。

42
00:02:01,770 --> 00:02:02,610
Now here's a 20.
这是20美元。

43
00:02:03,050 --> 00:02:04,429
Ah, okay, that's uh,
啊，好的，那是，呃，

44
00:02:06,490 --> 00:02:11,489
a dollar and 30 cents change.
找您1美元30美分。

45
00:02:12,610 --> 00:02:13,249
There we go.
给您。

46
00:02:13,810 --> 00:02:15,290
Will make 20.
凑整20美元吧。

47
00:02:15,650 --> 00:02:16,069
Thanks.
谢谢。

48
00:02:17,210 --> 00:02:17,730
Thank you.
谢谢你。

49
00:02:18,570 --> 00:02:19,730
Thanks for the directions.
谢谢指路。

50
00:02:58,711 --> 00:03:00,230
This must be Pete's barn.
这一定是皮特的谷仓。

51
00:03:01,951 --> 00:03:03,191
Turn right to the house.
向右转，去那栋房子。

52
00:03:14,201 --> 00:03:14,561
Hi.
嗨。

53
00:03:14,801 --> 00:03:16,040
Hi, what can I do for you?
嗨，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

54
00:03:16,641 --> 00:03:17,960
Is this the Pete Waters farm?
这是皮特·沃特斯农场吗？

55
00:03:18,161 --> 00:03:18,520
It is.
是的。

56
00:03:19,441 --> 00:03:20,341
I'm a friend of Pete's.
我是皮特的朋友。

57
00:03:20,401 --> 00:03:21,240
I'm looking for the house.
我在找那栋房子。

58
00:03:21,561 --> 00:03:22,520
It's just over yonder.
就在前面不远处。

59
00:03:22,841 --> 00:03:24,780
Keep along this road till you get to the end of the fence.
沿着这条路一直走到栅栏尽头。

60
00:03:24,841 --> 00:03:26,001
You'll see the chicken house.
你会看到鸡舍。

61
00:03:26,121 --> 00:03:27,260
His house is on the left.
他的房子在左边。

62
00:03:27,531 --> 00:03:28,291
Oh, thanks.
哦，谢谢。

63
00:03:59,901 --> 00:04:04,501
I have gone to the railroad station, back soon with a surprise.
我去火车站了，很快就回来，有个惊喜给你。

64
00:04:05,341 --> 00:04:08,101
Make yourself at home, have a look around.
别客气，随便看看。

65
00:04:08,421 --> 00:04:08,740
Pete.
皮特。

66
00:04:11,861 --> 00:04:15,781
Same old Pete Waters, always full of surprises.
还是那个老皮特·沃特斯，总是充满惊喜。
48:
1
00:00:53,823 --> 00:00:58,223
Don't tell me, please don't tell me I recognize you.
别告诉我，求你别告诉我我认出你了。

2
00:00:58,343 --> 00:00:59,622
Oh, don't be silly, Arnie.
噢，别傻了，阿尼。

3
00:00:59,783 --> 00:01:03,682
Of course you recognize him, except for the beard he hasn't changed in 50 years.
你当然认得出他，除了胡子，他五十年来一点没变。

4
00:01:03,863 --> 00:01:05,143
It's Malcolm Stewart.
他是马尔科姆·斯图尔特。

5
00:01:05,463 --> 00:01:07,222
I know it's Malcolm Stewart.
我知道是马尔科姆·斯图尔特。

6
00:01:07,302 --> 00:01:08,922
You haven't changed much in 50 years.
五十年来你也没怎么变。

7
00:01:10,543 --> 00:01:11,063
Peggy.
佩吉。

8
00:01:12,103 --> 00:01:13,343
Peggy Pendleton.
佩吉·彭德尔顿。

9
00:01:13,383 --> 00:01:14,782
You're Peggy Pendleton.
你就是佩吉·彭德尔顿。

10
00:01:15,254 --> 00:01:16,613
Who am I, you old rascal?
我是谁啊，你这老顽童？

11
00:01:16,654 --> 00:01:17,934
You don't recognize me, do you?
你不认识我了，是吗？

12
00:01:18,534 --> 00:01:19,574
I know who you are.
我知道你是谁。

13
00:01:20,334 --> 00:01:21,934
You're Arnold Franklin.
你是阿诺德·富兰克林。

14
00:01:22,294 --> 00:01:24,813
Oh, I know who you are.
噢，我知道你是谁。

15
00:01:26,094 --> 00:01:27,693
You look wonderful, Malcolm.
你看起来真棒，马尔科姆。

16
00:01:29,374 --> 00:01:30,093
Oh.
噢。

17
00:01:32,974 --> 00:01:34,333
Sit down, sit down.
坐下，快坐下。

18
00:01:35,294 --> 00:01:36,005
Pete isn't home.
皮特不在家。

19
00:01:36,206 --> 00:01:36,565
Really?
真的吗？

20
00:01:38,606 --> 00:01:41,745
Oh, he left a note on the door saying he was going to the,
噢，他在门上留了张条子，说他要到那个，

21
00:01:41,806 --> 00:01:44,885
uh, railroad station to pick up a surprise.
呃，火车站去接一个惊喜。

22
00:01:45,086 --> 00:01:45,905
He's so funny.
他真有趣。

23
00:01:46,206 --> 00:01:48,926
Always full of surprises, even 50 years later.
总是充满惊喜，五十年后依然如此。

24
00:01:50,486 --> 00:01:52,885
The two of you look unbelievable.
你们俩看起来简直难以置信。

25
00:01:53,926 --> 00:01:54,706
How's your family?
你的家人怎么样？

26
00:01:55,206 --> 00:01:57,966
Oh, I was sorry to hear about your wife having passed away.
噢，听说你妻子去世了，我很遗憾。

27
00:01:58,686 --> 00:02:00,286
Yes, about 4 years ago.
是的，大约四年前。

28
00:02:00,686 --> 00:02:03,197
And you're living with your children now in New York?
你现在和孩子们住在纽约吗？

29
00:02:03,437 --> 00:02:04,596
Pete wrote us and told us.
皮特写信告诉过我们。

30
00:02:04,917 --> 00:02:09,957
Yep, retired and moved to New York to
对，退休后就搬到了纽约，

31
00:02:10,157 --> 00:02:12,237
live with my son and his family.
和我儿子及他的家人住在一起。

32
00:02:12,557 --> 00:02:15,237
By the way, what do you think this big surprise is?
顺便问一下，你觉得这个大大的惊喜会是什么？

33
00:02:15,997 --> 00:02:17,837
It could be most anything, knowing Pete.
了解皮特的话，可能是任何东西。

34
00:02:20,557 --> 00:02:22,316
Hey, that must be Pete.
嘿，那一定是皮特。

35
00:02:23,597 --> 00:02:25,508
Now we'll find out about the surprise.
现在我们要知道惊喜是什么了。

36
00:02:29,189 --> 00:02:30,308
So good to see you all.
很高兴见到大家。

37
00:02:30,388 --> 00:02:31,009
Hi, Pete.
嗨，皮特。

38
00:02:31,029 --> 00:02:34,668
Pete, Pete, oh, it's so good to see you.
皮特，皮特，噢，见到你真高兴。

39
00:02:36,829 --> 00:02:37,788
Remember Lillian?
还记得莉莲吗？

40
00:02:38,509 --> 00:02:39,709
I remember all of you.
我都记得你们。

41
00:02:39,909 --> 00:02:41,108
You haven't changed a bit.
你一点都没变。

42
00:02:41,349 --> 00:02:41,869
Lillian?
莉莲？

43
00:02:42,389 --> 00:02:43,929
Oh my gosh.
天哪。

44
00:02:45,629 --> 00:02:48,120
We were together in the Thursday night drama society.
我们以前在周四晚上的戏剧社一起待过。

45
00:02:48,820 --> 00:02:50,019
Remember me, Malcolm?
还记得我吗，马尔科姆？

46
00:02:50,300 --> 00:02:52,379
Oh, beautiful as ever, Lillian.
噢，还是那么美，莉莲。

47
00:02:53,020 --> 00:02:53,740
How's Donald?
唐纳德怎么样？

48
00:02:55,260 --> 00:02:56,300
That's okay, Malcolm.
没事的，马尔科姆。

49
00:02:57,100 --> 00:02:59,219
Donald passed away a couple of years ago.
唐纳德几年前去世了。

50
00:02:59,340 --> 00:03:00,609
Oh, I'm so sorry.
噢，我真抱歉。

51
00:03:00,689 --> 00:03:03,259
I would not have missed this get-together for the world.
我无论如何都不会错过这次聚会。

52
00:03:03,580 --> 00:03:05,140
And your little surprise, Pete.
还有你给我们的小惊喜，皮特。

53
00:03:05,700 --> 00:03:08,780
You really surprised me by having us all come together.
你把我们都召集到一起，真是让我大吃一惊。

54
00:03:09,900 --> 00:03:12,371
You don't know what the surprise is yet?
你还不知道惊喜是什么吗？

55
00:03:13,852 --> 00:03:14,811
Come on!
来吧！

56
00:03:15,412 --> 00:03:17,532
We'll tell you the big surprise.
我们会告诉你这个大大的惊喜。

57
00:03:19,212 --> 00:03:22,012
Come on, it's time for the world.
来吧，是时候揭晓了。

58

说明这两人不应合法结婚？

15
00:02:16,707 --> 00:02:18,546
Then, Harry Bennett,
那么，哈里·贝内特，

16
00:02:19,187 --> 00:02:22,426
do you take Susan Stewart to be your lawful wedded wife?
你愿意娶苏珊·斯图尔特为你的合法妻子吗？

17
00:02:25,067 --> 00:02:25,547
I do.
我愿意。

18
00:02:27,427 --> 00:02:29,249
And you, Susan Stewart,
而你，苏珊·斯图尔特，

19
00:02:29,649 --> 00:02:32,569
do you take Harry Bennett to be your lawful wedded husband?
你愿意嫁给哈里·贝内特为你的合法丈夫吗？

20
00:02:34,889 --> 00:02:35,389
I do.
我愿意。

21
00:02:36,489 --> 00:02:37,449
The rings, please.
请递上戒指。

22
00:02:40,929 --> 00:02:41,928
I have them, Harry.
我拿着呢，哈里。

23
00:03:08,630 --> 00:03:12,629
By the power vested in me by the laws of the state of New York,
根据纽约州法律赋予我的权力，

24
00:03:13,310 --> 00:03:15,910
I now pronounce you husband and wife.
我现在宣布你们结为夫妻。

25
00:03:17,532 --> 00:03:19,612
You may kiss the bride now, Harry.
哈里，你现在可以亲吻新娘了。
58:
1
00:00:03,480 --> 00:00:04,200
Where's mom?
妈妈去哪儿了？

2
00:00:04,960 --> 00:00:06,320
She went to a school board meeting.
她去参加学校董事会会议了。

3
00:00:07,920 --> 00:00:09,080
I don't know how she does it.
我真不知道她是怎么做到的。

4
00:00:09,160 --> 00:00:10,359
She sure keeps busy.
她确实很忙。

5
00:00:11,120 --> 00:00:12,200
It's important to her.
这对她很重要。

6
00:00:13,280 --> 00:00:16,559
There are lots of places to go, lots of things to do.
有很多地方要去，有很多事要做。

7
00:00:17,720 --> 00:00:19,839
She can't sit around and do nothing.
她闲不住。

8
00:00:20,320 --> 00:00:21,280
Philip works late.
菲利普工作到很晚。

9
00:00:22,360 --> 00:00:23,199
I guess you're right.
我想你是对的。

10
00:00:24,520 --> 00:00:25,879
I wish I had her energy.
我希望我有她的精力。

11
00:00:27,640 --> 00:00:28,359
Anybody home?
有人在家吗？

12
00:00:28,800 --> 00:00:29,699
We're in here, Dad.
我们在这儿，爸爸。

13
00:00:31,979 --> 00:00:33,659
Oh, hi, gang.
哦，嗨，孩子们。

14
00:00:34,219 --> 00:00:34,919
Hello, Philip.
你好，菲利普。

15
00:00:35,059 --> 00:00:35,859
How was your day?
你今天过得怎么样？

16
00:00:36,739 --> 00:00:38,339
Oh, my day was just fine.
哦，我今天挺好的。

17
00:00:39,219 --> 00:00:40,099
So was my night.
我的夜晚也挺好。

18
00:00:41,099 --> 00:00:42,178
So was 10 o'clock.
十点也挺好。

19
00:00:42,739 --> 00:00:43,059
Mm.
嗯。

20
00:00:44,419 --> 00:00:45,018
I'm starving.
我饿死了。

21
00:00:45,139 --> 00:00:46,658
Um, where's mom?
呃，妈妈去哪儿了？

22
00:00:47,099 --> 00:00:48,459
She went to a school board meeting.
她去参加学校董事会会议了。

23
00:00:48,939 --> 00:00:51,178
There's a note for you on the refrigerator.
冰箱上有一张给你的便条。

24
00:00:51,939 --> 00:00:52,298
Oh?
哦？

25
00:01:29,139 --> 00:01:30,059
Did you have dinner, Robbie?
罗比，你吃晚饭了吗？

26
00:01:30,419 --> 00:01:32,738
Yeah, Mike and I had a hamburger at the diner.
吃了，我和迈克在餐馆吃了汉堡。

27
00:01:32,818 --> 00:01:34,059
I came home a little while ago.
我刚才才回家。

28
00:01:35,619 --> 00:01:37,699
You've been working late almost every night this week,
这周你几乎每天晚上都工作到很晚，

29
00:01:37,819 --> 00:01:38,119
Dad.
爸爸。

30
00:01:38,299 --> 00:01:39,339
Aren't you exhausted?
你不累吗？

31
00:01:40,859 --> 00:01:42,238
I don't have time to be exhausted.
我没时间觉得累。

32
00:01:43,439 --> 00:01:46,438
You and Mom haven't had dinner together with us in almost a full week.
你和妈妈已经快整整一周没和我们一起吃晚饭了。

33
00:01:47,279 --> 00:01:47,598
Yeah.
是啊。

34
00:01:48,519 --> 00:01:50,639
I feel bad about us not having dinner with the family,
没能和家人一起吃晚饭，我也挺难受的，

35
00:01:50,719 --> 00:01:52,919
but, uh, our schedules are so different.
但是，呃，我们的日程安排太不一样了。

36
00:01:53,399 --> 00:01:55,199
Either I'm at the hospital doing paperwork,
要么我在医院处理文书工作，

37
00:01:55,339 --> 00:01:56,879
or Mom is at a committee meeting.
要么妈妈在开委员会会议。

38
00:01:57,839 --> 00:02:00,558
I, frankly, don't know what to do about it.
说实话，我不知道该怎么办。

39
00:02:01,959 --> 00:02:03,359
I'm worried about you and Mom.
我担心你和妈妈。

40
00:02:04,359 --> 00:02:06,199
You really have been working too hard.
你真的工作太辛苦了。

41
00:02:07,179 --> 00:02:08,658
Well, I think I've had enough of that sandwich.
好吧，我觉得那个三明治我已经吃得够多了。

42
00:02:09,739 --> 00:02:10,658
You didn't finish it.
你没吃完啊。

43
00:02:14,659 --> 00:02:16,499
It's not good to eat before going to bed.
睡前吃东西不好。

44
00:02:18,819 --> 00:02:19,739
Cookie can't hurt though.
不过饼干应该没关系。

45
00:02:22,339 --> 00:02:25,699
Well, I'm heading off for bed and, a good night's sleep.
好了，我要去睡觉了，好好睡一觉。

46
00:02:26,299 --> 00:02:26,979
Well, good night.
好吧，晚安。

47
00:02:27,739 --> 00:02:28,459
Good night, son.
晚安，儿子。

48
00:02:30,939 --> 00:02:31,559
Good night, Dad.
晚安，爸爸。

49
00:02:31,639 --> 00:02:32,538
I'm, uh, going to bed.
我，呃，也要去睡了。

50
00:02:32,959 --> 00:02:33,678
Good night, Philip.
晚安，菲利普。

51
00:02:35,119 --> 00:02:36,679
Haven't you finished balancing that checkbook?
你还没把那本支票簿的账对完吗？

52
00:02:37,319 --> 00:02:38,878
I found another mistake.
我又发现了一个错误。

53
00:02:40,319 --> 00:02:42,198
I'll be off to bed myself in a minute.
我马上也去睡觉了。

54
00:02:42,439 --> 00:02:42,739
Okay.
好的。

55
00:02:43,359 --> 00:02:43,678
Night.
晚安。

56
00:02:52,599 --> 00:02:54,378
I'm really concerned about them, Grandpa.
爷爷，我真的很担心他们。

57
00:02:55,279 --> 00:02:56,418
Concerned about whom?
担心谁？

58
00:02:57,019 --> 00:02:58,058
About mom and dad.
关于爸爸妈妈。

59
00:02:59,019 --> 00:03:00,499
They hardly ever see each other.
他们几乎见不到彼此。

60
00:03:01,419 --> 00:03:04,858
Dad often works late, and mom has all these committees she's on.
爸爸经常工作到很晚，妈妈又参加了那么多委员会。

61
00:03:05,819 --> 00:03:07,939
What do you propose to do about it?
那你打算怎么办？

62
00:03:08,299 --> 00:03:10,058
You have that look in your eye.
你眼神里又有那种神情了。

63
00:03:10,739 --> 00:03:15,298
I don't know, but there must be a way of getting them to spend more time together.
我不知道，但一定有什么办法能让他们多花点时间在一起。

64
00:03:16,139 --> 00:03:17,099
Quality time.
高质量的陪伴时间。
59:
1
00:00:46,829 --> 00:00:48,149
Hello there, Robbie.
你好，罗比。

2
00:00:49,189 --> 00:00:50,548
What are you doing up this late?
这么晚了，你怎么还没睡？

3
00:00:51,579 --> 00:00:51,938
Reading.
在看书。

4
00:00:52,779 --> 00:00:53,218
Reading?
看书？

5
00:00:53,539 --> 00:00:54,299
At this hour?
这个点还看？

6
00:00:54,539 --> 00:00:55,558
Oh, come on, Robbie.
哎呀，罗比。

7
00:00:55,579 --> 00:00:56,779
What are you doing up this late?
这么晚了，你在干什么呢？

8
00:00:57,899 --> 00:00:58,779
Things on my mind.
心里有事。

9
00:01:00,699 --> 00:01:01,019
Oh.
哦。

10
00:01:01,619 --> 00:01:03,459
Do you care to talk about them?
你愿意说说吗？

11
00:01:05,459 --> 00:01:06,738
Sure, if you don't mind listening.
当然，如果你不介意听的话。

12
00:01:08,419 --> 00:01:08,938
Robbie.
罗比。

13
00:01:09,579 --> 00:01:10,619
Robbie, remember me?
罗比，还记得我吗？

14
00:01:11,099 --> 00:01:11,779
I'm your mother.
我是你妈妈。

15
00:01:12,979 --> 00:01:15,208
If you have something you want to talk about,
如果你有想聊的事，

16
00:01:15,288 --> 00:01:16,788
I'm always prepared to listen.
我随时准备倾听。

17
00:01:18,308 --> 00:01:19,848
You haven't been around much lately.
你最近很少在家。

18
00:01:22,288 --> 00:01:23,027
So that's it.
所以就这样吧。

19
00:01:24,848 --> 00:01:25,747
Okay, let's talk.
好吧，我们聊聊。

20
00:01:26,608 --> 00:01:29,048
You and Dad are like ships that pass in the night.
你和爸爸就像夜间擦肩而过的船。

21
00:01:30,168 --> 00:01:31,968
Dad works hard and he works late.
爸爸工作很努力，而且经常加班到很晚。

22
00:01:32,888 --> 00:01:35,687
You work hard on all your committees and you work late.
你也在各个委员会上忙得不可开交，也总是很晚才回家。

23
00:01:36,128 --> 00:01:38,158
I thought you were proud of the work I do.
我以为你会为我所做的工作感到骄傲。

24
00:01:38,478 --> 00:01:40,477
I am, Mom, real proud.
是的，妈妈，真的很骄傲。

25
00:01:41,678 --> 00:01:43,518
You are one fantastic mom, but.
你是个了不起的妈妈，但是……

26
00:01:43,518 --> 00:01:43,519
.
……

27
00:01:43,518 --> 00:01:43,818
.
……

28
00:01:45,318 --> 00:01:49,217
but I've been noticing how little quality
但我注意到，

29
00:01:49,358 --> 00:01:53,017
time you spend with Dad and me, and the family.
你和爸爸以及家人共度的高质量时间太少了。

30
00:01:58,198 --> 00:01:59,558
That's a real problem, Robbie.
这确实是个大问题，罗比。

31
00:02:00,707 --> 00:02:01,307
I know it.
我知道。

32
00:02:05,227 --> 00:02:06,227
I'm concerned.
我很担心。

33
00:02:07,627 --> 00:02:11,066
There must be a way that Dad and you can spend more time together.
一定有什么办法能让爸爸和你多花些时间在一起。

34
00:02:13,427 --> 00:02:16,286
Well, we always talk about taking a vacation together
嗯，我们总说想和家人一起度个假，

35
00:02:16,827 --> 00:02:17,627
with the family.
和家人一起。

36
00:02:19,067 --> 00:02:21,786
I think you ought to take a vacation away from the family,
我觉得你应该离开家人去度个假，

37
00:02:22,507 --> 00:02:25,096
alone, kind of a second honeymoon.
单独去，算是第二次蜜月吧。

38
00:02:26,737 --> 00:02:29,776
It would be wonderful, but our schedules won't allow it.
那会很美好，但我们的日程安排不允许。

39
00:02:30,697 --> 00:02:31,816
I think I have an idea.
我想我有个主意。

40
00:02:33,817 --> 00:02:34,236
You do?
你有？

41
00:02:34,577 --> 00:02:34,896
Yep.
对。

42
00:02:35,537 --> 00:02:38,016
I think I have an idea that will bring Dad
我想有个主意，

43
00:02:38,057 --> 00:02:40,257
and you together in a more scheduled way.
能让爸爸和你以更规律的方式聚在一起。

44
00:02:41,777 --> 00:02:42,436
Well, what is it?
是什么主意？

45
00:02:43,537 --> 00:02:46,436
Well, you know how Dad is always talking about the kids in the ward
你知道爸爸总是谈论教区里的孩子们，

46
00:02:47,007 --> 00:02:49,606
and how important it is for them to be paid attention to?
以及他们多么需要被关注，对吧？

47
00:02:49,647 --> 00:02:50,107
Yes.
是的。

48
00:02:50,807 --> 00:02:54,127
Well, and how hard it is because the doctors and nurses are so busy?
还有因为医生和护士太忙，这件事有多难做，对吧？

49
00:02:54,647 --> 00:02:55,086
Yes.
是的。

50
00:02:56,847 --> 00:02:59,237
Well, how would it be if you took some time
那么，如果你抽出一些时间

51
00:02:59,317 --> 00:03:02,127
to work with Dad towards solving that problem?
花些时间和爸爸一起解决这个问题，怎么样？

52
00:03:03,247 --> 00:03:03,967
I don't get it.
我不明白。

53
00:03:04,607 --> 00:03:07,967
Like setting up a regular weekly reading program.
比如设立一个每周固定的阅读计划。

54
00:03:08,767 --> 00:03:09,567
You and Dad.
你和爸爸。

55
00:03:10,156 --> 00:03:10,955
You and Dr.
你和菲利普·斯图尔特医生。

56
00:03:11,076 --> 00:03:14,536
Philip Stewart going to the children's ward once or twice a week
每周去儿童病房一两次，

57
00:03:14,916 --> 00:03:16,076
and reading to them.
给他们读书。

58
00:03:17,836 --> 00:03:18,635
Not bad.
不错。

59
00:03:19,556 --> 00:03:21,115
Not a bad idea, Robbie.
是个好主意，罗比。

60
00:03:21,676 --> 00:03:22,596
As a matter of fact,
事实上，

61
00:03:22,656 --> 00:03:24,455
it fits right in with something I'm working
这正好和我现在

62
00:03:24,496 --> 00:03:26,315
on right now with the school board committee.
与校董会委员会合作推进的一件事很契合。

63
00:03:26,756 --> 00:03:27,276
What's that?
那是什么？

64
00:03:28,676 --> 00:03:32,316
I've been trying to work out a program in the public school
我一直在公立学校尝试制定一个项目，

65
00:03:32,676 --> 00:03:35,945
that will bring parents and teachers together
让家长和老师们每周聚在一起，

66
00:03:36,106 --> 00:03:39,055
once a week to read to the students, their own children,
给孩子们读书，读给自己的孩子听，

67
00:03:39,135 --> 00:03:39,545
really.
真的。

68
00:03:40,226 --> 00:03:42,226
By doing that, it will encourage reading.
这样做能鼓励阅读。

69
00:03:42,986 --> 00:03:46,905
So it might fit in with a program for reading to the kids in the hospital.
所以这可能和给医院里的孩子们读书的计划很合适。

70
00:03:47,906 --> 00:03:48,545
You're right.
你说得对。

71
00:03:49,186 --> 00:03:49,866
We'll do it.
我们就这么做吧。

72
00:03:50,386 --> 00:03:52,186
I'm going to talk to Daddy about it right now.
我现在就去跟爸爸说这件事。

73
00:03:53,146 --> 00:03:55,866
But Dad was so exhausted when he came home from work.
可是爸爸下班回家时累坏了。

74
00:03:56,495 --> 00:03:58,254
Why don't you talk to him about it tomorrow?
你为什么不明天再跟他谈呢？

75
00:03:59,575 --> 00:04:02,374
You are a very smart young man, Robbie.
你是个非常聪明的孩子，罗比。

76
00:04:02,975 --> 00:04:04,495
I think I'll wait until tomorrow.
我想我会等到明天。

77
00:04:05,735 --> 00:04:06,854
You won't forget, will you?
你不会忘记的，对吧？

78
00:04:07,175 --> 00:04:08,854
Oh, believe me, I won't.
哦，相信我，我不会忘的。

79
00:04:09,415 --> 00:04:12,895
It is a great idea, and I promise you I won't forget.
这是个很棒的主意，我向你保证我不会忘记。

80
00:04:13,935 --> 00:04:14,534
Thanks, Mom.
谢谢妈妈。

81
00:04:15,255 --> 00:04:16,295
Thank you, Robbie.
谢谢你，罗比。
60:
1
00:00:15,800 --> 00:00:16,639
Good morning.
早上好。

2
00:00:17,640 --> 00:00:19,800
Oh, what a wonderful morning.
哦，多么美好的早晨啊。

3
00:00:19,960 --> 00:00:21,719
Don't the flowers smell wonderful?
花香是不是特别怡人？

4
00:00:22,400 --> 00:00:23,280
Good morning, Ellen.
早上好，艾伦。

5
00:00:24,440 --> 00:00:25,240
Yes, they do.
是啊，确实很香。

6
00:00:25,960 --> 00:00:29,966
That's why I'm reading my paper and having my coffee on the patio this morning.
所以我今天早上才在露台上看报纸、喝咖啡。

7
00:00:32,706 --> 00:00:34,926
Ah, it does smell sweet.
啊，闻起来真甜。

8
00:00:36,786 --> 00:00:38,905
How was your school board meeting last night?
昨晚的学校董事会会议开得怎么样？

9
00:00:38,946 --> 00:00:40,225
You must have come home very late.
你肯定很晚才回家吧。

10
00:00:40,986 --> 00:00:42,566
Did you find the sandwich I made for you?
我为你做的三明治找到了吗？

11
00:00:42,946 --> 00:00:43,266
Mm.
嗯。

12
00:00:43,706 --> 00:00:44,245
Thanks, dear.
谢谢，亲爱的。

13
00:00:45,346 --> 00:00:48,705
I, uh, I was so tired I didn't even finish it.
我，呃，我太累了，连三明治都没吃完。

14
00:00:51,146 --> 00:00:55,321
Philip, I've been working on a special project
菲利普，我一直在做一个特别的项目，

15
00:00:55,401 --> 00:00:58,731
with the school board, and I'd like your opinion about it.
是和学校董事会一起做的，我想听听你的意见。

16
00:00:59,972 --> 00:01:00,491
What is it?
是什么项目？

17
00:01:02,252 --> 00:01:05,712
I've been trying to find a way to encourage reading.
我一直在想办法鼓励大家阅读。

18
00:01:07,252 --> 00:01:07,852
Good luck.
祝你好运。

19
00:01:08,852 --> 00:01:10,971
Well, I think I may have found a way to do it.
嗯，我觉得我可能找到办法了。

20
00:01:11,572 --> 00:01:12,652
Yeah, tell me about it.
是吗，说来听听。

21
00:01:12,812 --> 00:01:14,998
I work with families every day, Ellen.
艾伦，我每天接触很多家庭。

22
00:01:15,438 --> 00:01:17,958
I see how people spend their leisure time,
我看到人们怎么打发闲暇时间，

00:03:01,516 --> 00:03:04,755

我真的想为这个国家最大的公司工作吗？

71
00:03:05,596 --> 00:03:06,035
And?
结果呢？

72
00:03:06,876 --> 00:03:07,556

我不想。

73
00:03:08,236 --> 00:03:11,378
I went into business for myself because I like being my own boss.
我创业是因为我喜欢自己做老板。

74
00:03:12,978 --> 00:03:14,057
I run my own company.
我经营自己的公司。

75
00:03:14,338 --> 00:03:16,098
I'm a big fish in a little pond.
在小池塘里，我是条大鱼。

76
00:03:16,978 --> 00:03:19,218
I'm not really sure I want to be a little fish in a big pond.
我不确定我想在大池塘里当条小鱼。

77
00:03:20,618 --> 00:03:23,138
Oh, Daddy, does that mean we don't have to move?
哦，爸爸，这是说我们不用搬家了吗？

78
00:03:23,258 --> 00:03:24,098
That's right, sweetheart.
没错，宝贝。

79
00:03:25,418 --> 00:03:26,057
Are you sure?
你确定吗？

80
00:03:27,618 --> 00:03:28,897
I couldn't be more sure, Susan.
我非常确定，苏珊。

81
00:03:31,058 --> 00:03:32,760
I'm glad if you are, Harry.
如果你确定，那我就放心了，哈里。

82
00:03:33,081 --> 00:03:35,900
And besides, how could I live in Los Angeles
再说了，我怎么能住在洛杉矶，

83
00:03:36,521 --> 00:03:38,121

而我所有喜欢的人都在这里呢？

84
00:03:39,241 --> 00:03:40,121
Your favorite people?
你喜欢的人？

85
00:03:40,881 --> 00:03:41,521
Who's that?
是谁呀？

86
00:03:42,521 --> 00:03:43,961
The Stewart family, of course.
当然是斯图尔特一家啦。

当树枝折断，摇篮会

00:00:23,640 --> 00:00:28,535
cradle and all.

00:00:40,496 --> 00:00:41,175
Hi, Marilyn.
嗨，玛丽莲。

9
00:00:42,656 --> 00:00:43,255

你在做什么？

10
00:00:46,336 --> 00:00:47,496
Just sketching.
只是画画草图。

11
00:00:53,392 --> 00:00:55,792

过去几周我一直在思考我们的责任

12
00:00:56,152 --> 00:00:57,131

过去几周里。

13
00:00:57,512 --> 00:00:58,912

我从未停止过思考这些。

14
00:01:00,912 --> 00:01:03,072
I've been wrestling with the question of whether
我一直在纠结是否

15
00:01:03,432 --> 00:01:04,751
I go back to work or not.
回去工作这个问题。

16
00:01:05,112 --> 00:01:05,592
I see.
我明白了。

17
00:01:05,912 --> 00:01:06,592
And I'm torn.
我很矛盾。

18
00:01:06,912 --> 00:01:08,632
I really want to go back to work,
我真的很想回去工作，

19
00:01:09,752 --> 00:01:11,981
use my talents and pursue my career in
发挥我的才能，追求我在

00:01:12,061 --> 00:01:13,888

时装设计领域的事业，就像我们一直以为我会做的那样，

00:01:14,008 --> 00:01:17,888

但现在我想全职陪伴麦克斯，

22
00:01:19,448 --> 00:01:20,807
especially when he's a baby.
尤其是当他还是个婴儿的时候。

23
00:01:22,288 --> 00:01:25,487
I really understand, Marilyn, but you never have to worry about Max.
我完全理解，玛丽莲，但你永远不必为麦克斯担心。

24
00:01:26,288 --> 00:01:27,728
There's mother and grandpa,
有妈妈和爷爷在，

25
00:01:27,968 --> 00:01:31,527

而且如果有帮助的话，我可以随时根据你的时间安排我的摄影日程。

26
00:01:34,408 --> 00:01:35,824

这不一样，理查德。

27
00:01:39,265 --> 00:01:41,304

你和老板谈过回去工作的事吗？

28

丽塔·梅昨天打电话来了。

29
00:01:44,385 --> 00:01:47,064

啊，这就是让你思考的原因，对吧？

30
00:01:48,665 --> 00:01:51,185

她想知道我觉得自己什么时候能回到精品店。

31
00:01:51,945 --> 00:01:52,925

你怎么说的？

32
00:01:53,905 --> 00:01:55,961
I said I'd give her an answer in a few days,
我说几天后给她答复，

33
00:01:57,401 --> 00:01:58,800

说我还没确定。

34
00:01:59,761 --> 00:02:03,700
I'm sure Rita Mae will understand and wait until you're ready to go back to work.
我相信丽塔·梅会理解并等你准备好再回去工作。

35
00:02:04,881 --> 00:02:06,840
Well, maybe she will and maybe she won't.
嗯，也许她会，也许不会。

36
00:02:06,961 --> 00:02:07,560
Who knows?
谁知道呢？

37
00:02:09,241 --> 00:02:13,351
If I don't accept her offer, maybe she'll find someone else in the meantime,
如果我不接受她的提议，也许在此期间她会找到其他人，

38
00:02:13,431 --> 00:02:15,740
and when I'm ready to go back, there won't be a job for me.
等我准备回去时，就没有职位给我了。

39
00:02:15,921 --> 00:02:17,281
Oh, that's something to consider.
哦，这确实值得考虑。

40
00:02:18,321 --> 00:02:20,017
You've got yourself to think about too.
你也得为自己想想。

41
00:02:20,897 --> 00:02:23,177
But I am thinking about myself, don't you see?
但我确实在为自己着想，你没看出来吗？

42
00:02:23,417 --> 00:02:24,096
Now, what do you mean?
那么，你是什么意思？

43
00:02:25,657 --> 00:02:26,976
It's not just the job.
不仅仅是工作的问题。

44
00:02:27,977 --> 00:02:28,337
It's also.
还有……

45
00:02:28,337 --> 00:02:28,338
.
。

46
00:02:28,337 --> 00:02:28,837
.
。

47
00:02:31,217 --> 00:02:34,296
my career as Max's mother.
作为麦克斯母亲的职业生涯。

48
00:02:36,617 --> 00:02:37,696
That's the way I look at it.
我是这样看待的。

49
00:02:38,777 --> 00:02:41,257
I have two career opportunities at the same time.
我同时拥有两个职业机会。

50
00:02:42,137 --> 00:02:44,672
My career as a fashion designer and my career as a mother.
一个是时装设计师的职业，另一个是母亲的角色。

51
00:02:45,913 --> 00:02:50,312
I never really thought about being a mother as a career.
我从来没真正想过当母亲也是一种职业。

52
00:02:52,233 --> 00:02:54,372
I guess you do have two career opportunities
我想你确实有两个职业机会

53
00:02:55,393 --> 00:02:56,593
and a decision to make.
而且要做个决定。

54
00:02:59,073 --> 00:02:59,952
Oh, I hear Max.
哦，我听到麦克斯的声音了。

55
00:03:00,633 --> 00:03:01,132
I'll go to him.
我去他那儿。

56
00:03:01,153 --> 00:03:01,993
No, that's okay.
不，没关系。

57
00:03:02,153 --> 00:03:02,752
I'll do it.
我来做。

1
00:00:08,360 --> 00:00:10,679

这是你的泰迪熊，麦克斯。

00:00:13,880 --> 00:00:17,039
He just loves that teddy bear that Grandpa Philip bought for him.
他就是喜欢菲利普爷爷给他买的那只泰迪熊。

3
00:00:19,840 --> 00:00:22,760
I took him to Philip's office yesterday for a checkup.
我昨天带他去菲利普的办公室做检查。

4
00:00:24,160 --> 00:00:28,460
You should have seen the look on his face when Molly gave him the injection.
你真该看看莫莉给他打针时他脸上的表情。

5
00:00:28,640 --> 00:00:30,382
Oh, did he cry?
哦，他哭了吗？

6
00:00:31,222 --> 00:00:31,542
No.
没有。

7
00:00:32,942 --> 00:00:36,862
My dear little boy just looked up at me as if to say,
我那亲爱的宝贝只是抬头看着我，好像在说：

8
00:00:37,662 --> 00:00:40,042
Mama, what are they doing to me?
妈妈，他们在对我做什么？

9
00:00:40,262 --> 00:00:40,562
Oh.
哦。

10
00:00:41,062 --> 00:00:41,662
Help.
救命。

11
00:00:43,222 --> 00:00:44,061
How did you feel?
你当时感觉怎么样？

12
00:00:44,662 --> 00:00:47,022
Tell the truth, didn't you feel terrible?
说实话，你是不是觉得很难受？

13
00:00:47,382 --> 00:00:48,302
I sure did.
确实如此。

14
00:00:50,142 --> 00:00:51,662
But I held him closely.
但我紧紧抱住了他。

15
00:00:52,702 --> 00:00:54,702
I kissed the top of his dear little head.
我亲吻了他那可爱的小脑袋顶。

16
00:00:57,285 --> 00:00:59,284
He looked up at me, he tried to smile.
他抬头看着我，努力想笑一笑。

17
00:01:04,205 --> 00:01:05,764
Being with him helped.
陪着他让我好受些。

18
00:01:08,085 --> 00:01:09,404
Helped him or helped you?
是帮了他，还是帮了你自己？

19
00:01:12,605 --> 00:01:15,404
Being a mother is not easy, if that's what you mean.
如果你的意思是这个，当妈妈真不容易。

20
00:01:19,867 --> 00:01:21,066
Speaking of being a mother,
说到当妈妈，

21
00:01:22,587 --> 00:01:25,386
I've been meaning to ask you what you were thinking about regarding
我一直想问问你，关于

22
00:01:26,347 --> 00:01:27,426
going back to work.
回去工作这件事，你是怎么想的。

23
00:01:27,987 --> 00:01:29,266
I know Rita May called.
我知道丽塔·梅打过电话来。

24
00:01:29,307 --> 00:01:31,587
I can imagine what is going through your head.
我能想象你脑子里在想什么。

25
00:01:32,027 --> 00:01:33,306
I'm sure you can, Ellen.
我相信你能理解，艾伦。

26
00:01:33,907 --> 00:01:35,906
There are so many things to consider.
有太多事情需要考虑。

27
00:01:37,067 --> 00:01:38,846
One thing that makes it easier for you is that,
有一件事能让你轻松一些，那就是，

28
00:01:39,147 --> 00:01:40,227
is that you have us.
那就是有我们在这儿。

29
00:01:41,747 --> 00:01:44,566
Max will always have a family member to watch
你去上班的时候，

30
00:01:45,050 --> 00:01:46,530
over him while you're at work.
总会有家人照看麦克斯。

31
00:01:47,210 --> 00:01:49,530
I didn't have that when Richard and Susan were born.
理查德和苏珊出生时，我没有这样的条件。

32
00:01:50,490 --> 00:01:51,250
What did you do?
那你当时是怎么做的？

33
00:01:53,210 --> 00:01:55,929
I chose to continue with my career as a music teacher.
我选择继续从事音乐教师的工作。

34
00:01:56,730 --> 00:01:59,409
We hired a woman to watch Richard and then Susan,
我们雇了一位女士先照看理查德，后来也照看苏珊，

35
00:02:01,250 --> 00:02:03,369
and I continued with my career.
而我则继续我的事业。

36
00:02:06,530 --> 00:02:08,312
Do you think you made the right decision?
你觉得你做了正确的决定吗？

37
00:02:09,953 --> 00:02:10,832
I think I did.
我觉得是的。

38
00:02:11,753 --> 00:02:13,142
But when Robbie was born,
但罗比出生后，

39
00:02:13,222 --> 00:02:16,913

我决定全心全意地抚养罗比。

40
00:02:17,473 --> 00:02:18,913
I felt differently at that time.
那时我的想法不同了。

41
00:02:19,593 --> 00:02:21,432
And you gave up your career as a music teacher?
所以你放弃了音乐教师的职业？

42
00:02:21,673 --> 00:02:22,473
Not exactly.
也不完全是。

43
00:02:23,033 --> 00:02:25,552
I continued to teach piano lessons at home.
我继续在家教钢琴课。

44
00:02:27,793 --> 00:02:32,775
How did you feel about being away when Susan and Richard were babies.
苏珊和理查德还是婴儿时，你不在他们身边，感觉如何？

45
00:02:34,655 --> 00:02:37,995
I think I did the right thing for them and for myself
我觉得对他们、对我自己，

46
00:02:38,535 --> 00:02:39,374
and for Philip.
还有对菲利普来说，我都做了正确的事。

47
00:02:39,615 --> 00:02:41,134
We needed the money, remember?
我们需要钱，记得吗？

48
00:02:41,495 --> 00:02:42,735
Well, we do too, Ellen.
嗯，我们也一样，艾伦。

49
00:02:44,175 --> 00:02:48,575
Everything I earn helps us towards getting that house we want
我赚的每一分钱都帮助我们攒钱买下我们想要

50
00:02:49,175 --> 00:02:49,835
and need.
并且需要的那栋房子。

51
00:02:50,375 --> 00:02:52,455
I can't wait till he's just a little older.
我迫不及待想等他再长大一点。

52
00:02:52,775 --> 00:02:55,615
Our toy company makes the most wonderful toys for kids.
我们的玩具公司为孩子们制作最棒的玩具。

53
00:02:57,415 --> 00:03:00,757
Max thanks you, I thank you, and Richard thanks you.
马克斯感谢你，我感谢你，理查德也感谢你。

54
00:03:01,158 --> 00:03:02,538
Now, may I please say hello?
现在，我可以打个招呼吗？

55
00:03:04,198 --> 00:03:04,678
Hello.
你好。

56
00:03:05,958 --> 00:03:06,437
Hello.
你好。

57
00:03:08,638 --> 00:03:11,257
I miss Max and think about him all week long.
我想念马克斯，整周都在想着他。

58
00:03:11,838 --> 00:03:13,197
We talk about him at dinner time.
我们晚饭时都会聊起他。

59
00:03:13,718 --> 00:03:15,067
Will you please try to relax?
你能试着放松点吗？

60
00:03:15,147 --> 00:03:16,637
I've never seen you so wound up.
我从没见过你这么紧张。

61
00:03:18,238 --> 00:03:20,357
You seem to be enjoying the pressure.
你似乎很享受这种压力。

62
00:03:21,638 --> 00:03:22,617
The truth is, I am.
说实话，我确实很享受。

63
00:03:23,358 --> 00:03:25,901
My job is not an easy one, but I really enjoy it.
我的工作并不轻松，但我真的很喜欢它。

64
00:03:26,981 --> 00:03:30,140
That is exactly what I wanted to talk to you about,
这正是我想和你谈的，

65
00:03:30,261 --> 00:03:30,621
Susan.
苏珊。

66
00:03:31,501 --> 00:03:32,220
What's the problem?
有什么问题吗？

67
00:03:32,941 --> 00:03:34,140
Marilyn's career.
玛丽莲的事业。

68
00:03:34,701 --> 00:03:37,420
Well, my choice of careers.
嗯，我的职业选择。

69
00:03:38,061 --> 00:03:38,500
Choice?
选择？

70
00:03:40,141 --> 00:03:44,200
My career as a fashion designer versus my
我作为时装设计师的职业， versus 我

71
00:03:44,341 --> 00:03:45,381
career as a mother.
作为母亲的职业。

72
00:03:46,381 --> 00:03:48,760
Well, why does it have to be one or the other?
为什么非得二选一呢？

73
00:03:49,141 --> 00:03:50,203
That's what I said.
我就是这么说的。

74
00:03:50,443 --> 00:03:51,003
How's that?
怎么回事？

75
00:03:52,083 --> 00:03:53,163
Why can't you do both?
你为什么不能两者兼顾？

76
00:03:54,963 --> 00:03:55,682
She's right.
她说得对。

77
00:03:56,883 --> 00:03:57,283
Both?
两者兼顾？

78
00:03:58,163 --> 00:03:59,082
And that's what I did.
而我就是这么做的。

79
00:03:59,603 --> 00:04:03,283
I did both with Richard and Susan, and I did both with Robbie.
我和理查德、苏珊在一起时做到了两者兼顾，和罗比在一起时也做到了。

80
00:04:03,923 --> 00:04:05,403

我以为你一直在家陪罗比。

81
00:04:05,803 --> 00:04:09,312
I did, but I was lucky enough to have a career as a music teacher,
我是待在家里，但我很幸运拥有一份音乐教师的职业，

82
00:04:09,392 --> 00:04:11,265

可以在家里继续从事这份工作。

83
00:04:14,586 --> 00:04:16,185
Why can't you work at home, Marilyn?
玛丽莲，你为什么不能在家工作呢？

84
00:04:17,266 --> 00:04:18,545
You're very talented.
你非常有才华。

85
00:04:19,786 --> 00:04:22,426
Designing dresses is a career you could establish
设计裙子是一份你可以

86
00:04:23,306 --> 00:04:24,545
out of your home, couldn't you?
在家就能建立起来的事业，不是吗？

87
00:04:28,386 --> 00:04:30,106
I don't know why I didn't think of it.
我不知道自己之前怎么没想到这一点。

88
00:04:32,786 --> 00:04:34,066
It seems so simple now.
现在看起来这么简单。

89
00:04:35,906 --> 00:04:38,426
For a year or two, I could stay at home with Max
有一两年时间，我可以待在家里陪马克斯，

90
00:04:39,689 --> 00:04:42,089
and do my dress designs.
同时做我的裙子设计。

91
00:04:43,769 --> 00:04:45,609
And you could make your dresses at home.
你可以在家制作你的裙子。

92
00:04:47,409 --> 00:04:49,649
Sounds like a great way to solve the problem.
听起来这是解决问题的好办法。

93
00:04:50,369 --> 00:04:52,448
That could solve your problem, Marilyn.
这或许能解决你的问题，玛丽莲。

94
00:04:54,249 --> 00:04:57,808
I'm going to call Rita Mae at home and ask her to come by and talk about it.
我要给丽塔·梅打电话，请她过来谈谈这件事。

95
00:04:58,449 --> 00:05:00,008
She wants to see Max anyway.
反正她也想见见马克斯。

96
00:05:01,289 --> 00:05:02,969
I think that really answers your questions,

48
00:02:15,934 --> 00:02:17,413

00:02:17,894 --> 00:02:20,934

罗比今早一早就出门去见亚历山德拉了。

.
。

.
。

马尔科姆。

问题。

我很乐意帮忙。

我们已获准在工作日进入那栋老建筑，

周二或周三都可以。

As I said, mostly the building just needs a good

一个社区中心，提供适合所有人的各类项目。

00:03:43,474 --> 00:03:46,194

00:03:46,874 --> 00:03:51,394

这要求很高，但如果不跟年轻人交流，

00:03:53,589 --> 00:03:55,909

Yes, here is a copy of all the things that we need to start with.
有的，这是我们起步所需物品的清单副本。

43
00:02:02,718 --> 00:02:03,158
Let's see.
让我看看。

44
00:02:03,358 --> 00:02:07,558
Four desks, eight straight back chairs, 30 folding chairs,
四张书桌，八把直背椅，三十把折叠椅，

45
00:02:07,718 --> 00:02:11,717
six table lamps, three end tables, one piano.
六盏台灯，三张边桌，一架钢琴。

46
00:02:12,438 --> 00:02:13,357
This is a good start.
这是个不错的开始。

47
00:02:14,238 --> 00:02:15,817
These items shouldn't be difficult to come
一旦我在报纸上刊登这篇文章，

48
00:02:15,878 --> 00:02:17,798
by once I print the article in the paper.
这些东西应该不难弄到。

49
00:02:18,678 --> 00:02:21,077
This community has always been very generous.
这个社区一直非常慷慨。

50
00:02:21,678 --> 00:02:22,378
I agree, Mr.
我同意，麦克斯韦

51
00:02:22,438 --> 00:02:22,757
Maxwell.
麦克斯韦尔。

52
00:02:23,437 --> 00:02:25,997
What you're saying is in order for this center to succeed,
你的意思是，为了让这个中心成功，

53
00:02:26,237 --> 00:02:30,397
we need to put together volunteers from the various generations of future users.
我们需要召集来自不同代际的未来用户组成志愿者团队。

54
00:02:30,797 --> 00:02:31,317
That's right.
没错。

55
00:02:31,597 --> 00:02:33,836
And without their energy and stamina,
如果没有他们的活力和耐力，

56
00:02:34,157 --> 00:02:37,057
there's no way we can complete this project.
我们根本无法完成这个项目。

57
00:02:37,517 --> 00:02:37,976
I've got it.
我明白了。

58
00:02:38,357 --> 00:02:41,676
Now give me some information about how you see the building being used.
现在给我讲讲你设想中这栋建筑将如何被使用。

59
00:02:41,917 --> 00:02:45,717
Oh, here on the ground floor, we have the reception.
哦，在一楼，我们有接待处。

60
00:02:46,757 --> 00:02:48,696
Mm-hmm.
嗯哼。

61
00:02:50,917 --> 00:02:51,797
It's here, Robbie.
在这儿，罗比。

62
00:02:52,677 --> 00:02:54,476
Charles Maxwell lived up to his word.
查尔斯·麦克斯韦尔信守了他的承诺。

63
00:02:56,157 --> 00:02:59,817
At the Stewart family home on Linden Street yesterday,
昨天在林登街的斯图尔特家宅，

64
00:03:00,637 --> 00:03:03,097
a group of caring Riverdale citizens
一群热心的里弗代尔市民

65
00:03:03,477 --> 00:03:06,957
gathered to plan the refurbishing of the old library
聚集在一起，筹划翻新旧图书馆，

66
00:03:07,477 --> 00:03:10,715
to transform it into a new community center.
将其改造成一个新的社区中心。

67
00:03:12,356 --> 00:03:15,836
The original plan by the council was tabled
理事会最初的计划因资金短缺而被搁置。

68
00:03:16,396 --> 00:03:18,115
because of lack of funds.
因为缺乏资金。

69
00:03:19,076 --> 00:03:21,476
The new plan needs you.
新计划需要你们。

70
00:03:22,756 --> 00:03:25,796
You could call it a community unity plan.
你可以称之为社区团结计划。

71
00:03:27,316 --> 00:03:30,696
It needs your time, and it needs your energy,
它需要你们的时间，也需要你们的精力，

72
00:03:31,396 --> 00:03:34,816
and it needs your contributions of furniture,
还需要你们捐赠家具、

73
00:03:35,396 --> 00:03:40,355
paint, brushes, ladders, lamps, etc.
油漆、刷子、梯子、灯具等物品。

74
00:03:41,836 --> 00:03:44,996
A list of these items and the volunteer form
这些物品的清单和志愿者报名表

75
00:03:45,636 --> 00:03:49,236
can be picked up at the Riverdale Press offices.
可在《里弗代尔新闻报》办公室领取。

76
00:03:50,436 --> 00:03:54,596
By working together, this community can do anything to benefit
通过共同努力，这个社区能够做任何事来造福

77
00:03:55,076 --> 00:03:55,916
its citizens.
其居民。

78
00:03:56,876 --> 00:03:59,776
And we know you will all work together
我们知道大家都会齐心协力，

79
00:04:00,316 --> 00:04:04,415
towards refurbishing the old library and making it a new
共同翻新旧图书馆，将其打造为新的

80
00:04:04,876 --> 00:04:06,036
community center.
社区中心。

81
00:04:07,316 --> 00:04:09,756
Charles Maxwell, editor.
查尔斯·麦克斯韦尔，编辑。

1
00:00:14,000 --> 00:00:14,519
Hi, Mom.
嗨，妈妈。

2
00:00:15,440 --> 00:00:16,019
Hi, Robbie.
嗨，罗比。

3
00:00:16,060 --> 00:00:17,200
You're home from school early.
你放学这么早就回家了。

4
00:00:17,520 --> 00:00:20,559
Yeah, they're getting the assembly hall ready for graduation ceremony,
是啊，他们正在为毕业典礼布置礼堂，

5
00:00:20,880 --> 00:00:22,240
so we all got to go home early.
所以我们都提前回家了。

6
00:00:22,600 --> 00:00:23,600
Too noisy to study.
太吵了，没法学习。

7
00:00:24,080 --> 00:00:26,039
Well, now that you're here, you can help me with dinner.
既然你回来了，就帮我准备晚餐吧。

8
00:00:26,280 --> 00:00:29,004
I need those potatoes, peeled and sliced.
我需要你把那些土豆削皮切片。

9
00:00:30,764 --> 00:00:32,084
Mom, give me a break.
妈，让我歇会儿吧。

10
00:00:32,564 --> 00:00:35,524
Alexandra's coming over to help me study for my math final.
亚历山德拉要来帮我复习数学期末考。

11
00:00:36,164 --> 00:00:41,003
Well, in that case, you can wash the dishes and clean up after dinner.
那样的话，你可以洗碗并在饭后收拾一下。

12
00:00:43,444 --> 00:00:45,484
Can I invite Alexandra to stay for dinner?
我可以邀请亚历山德拉留下来吃晚饭吗？

13
00:00:45,804 --> 00:00:46,604
Of course.
当然可以。

14
00:00:47,204 --> 00:00:47,843
Thanks, Mom.
谢谢妈妈。

15
00:00:52,089 --> 00:00:54,279
You and Alexandra have become good friends,
你和亚历山德拉成了好朋友，

16
00:00:54,359 --> 00:00:54,849
haven't you?
不是吗？

17
00:00:55,369 --> 00:00:56,369
Yes, I like her.
是的，我喜欢她。

18
00:00:56,769 --> 00:00:58,108
She's a terrific person.
她是个很棒的人。

19
00:01:01,289 --> 00:01:03,528
I'm going to miss her when she goes back to Greece.
等她回希腊后，我会想念她的。

20
00:01:05,689 --> 00:01:09,129
Would you like to give her a little farewell party?
你想为她举办一个小型告别派对吗？

21
00:01:10,049 --> 00:01:11,469
Mom, that would be terrific.
妈妈，那太好了。

22
00:01:12,409 --> 00:01:14,028
Maybe we could make it a surprise.
也许我们可以把它搞成惊喜派对。

23
00:01:14,849 --> 00:01:15,814
Oh, I don't know.
哦，我不知道。

24
00:01:16,014 --> 00:01:18,094
Surprise parties don't always work out.
惊喜派对并不总是成功的。

25
00:01:19,694 --> 00:01:23,254
Well, we could tell her it's a graduation party for me.
嗯，我们可以告诉她这是为我举办的毕业派对。

26
00:01:23,734 --> 00:01:26,374
When Alexandra arrives, we'll surprise her.
等亚历山德拉到了，我们就给她个惊喜。

27
00:01:27,974 --> 00:01:29,094
I suppose that might work.
我想那样或许行得通。

28
00:01:30,294 --> 00:01:32,413
I'd like to give her a nice going away present.
我想送她一份不错的离别礼物。

29
00:01:33,494 --> 00:01:33,914
Fine.
好吧。

30
00:01:34,534 --> 00:01:35,934
There's only one problem.
只有一个问题。

31
00:01:37,414 --> 00:01:38,053
What's that?
什么问题？

32
00:01:40,379 --> 00:01:41,039
I'm broke.
我没钱了。

33
00:01:41,819 --> 00:01:43,138
I should have saved some money.
我本该存点钱的。

34
00:01:43,779 --> 00:01:46,619
I'm sure Alexandra would be happy with something simple,
我相信亚历山德拉会喜欢简单些的东西的，

35
00:01:46,739 --> 00:01:47,098
Robbie.
罗比。

36
00:01:47,459 --> 00:01:49,498
I know, but well,
我知道，但是……

37
00:01:50,179 --> 00:01:52,979
I'd like to give her something nice to remember me by.
我想送她一件能让她记住我的好礼物。

38
00:01:54,579 --> 00:01:56,778
Maybe I could borrow some money from you and Dad.
也许我可以向你和爸爸借点钱。

39
00:01:58,779 --> 00:02:01,019
Well, it's all right with me if it's all right with your dad.
如果你爸爸同意，我也没问题。

40
00:02:01,699 --> 00:02:02,258
Thanks, Mom.
谢谢妈妈。

41
00:02:02,464 --> 00:02:03,383
I'll talk to him.
我去跟他谈谈。

42
00:02:03,904 --> 00:02:05,024
Is he still in his office?
他还在办公室吗？

43
00:02:05,184 --> 00:02:05,744
I think so.
我想是的。

44
00:02:06,984 --> 00:02:07,584
Thanks, Mom.
谢谢妈妈。

45
00:02:10,784 --> 00:02:11,164
Hmm.
嗯。

46
00:02:13,184 --> 00:02:13,744
Robbie!
罗比！

47
00:02:15,384 --> 00:02:16,104
Good luck.
祝你好运。

48
00:02:33,269 --> 00:02:34,728
Here are the X-rays you wanted, Dr.
这是您要的X光片，斯图尔特医生。

49
00:02:34,769 --> 00:02:35,009
Stewart.
斯图尔特。

50
00:02:35,069 --> 00:02:36,828
Oh, thank you, Molly.
哦，谢谢你，莫莉。

51
00:02:37,629 --> 00:02:38,749
Now let me check them.
让我检查一下。

52
00:02:51,274 --> 00:02:51,994
What do you think?
你觉得怎么样？

53
00:02:53,074 --> 00:02:55,513
Well, I don't see any breaks or fractures.
嗯，我没看到任何断裂或骨折。

54
00:02:56,474 --> 00:02:59,794
Well, well, thank you, Molly.
太好了，谢谢你，莫莉。

55
00:03:00,434 --> 00:03:01,434
Good, thank you.
好的，谢谢。

56
00:03:03,194 --> 00:03:03,713
Hmm.
嗯。

57
00:03:16,039 --> 00:03:16,519
Come in.
请进。

58
00:03:18,559 --> 00:03:19,198
Oh, hi, son.
哦，嗨，儿子。

59
00:03:19,399 --> 00:03:19,878
Hi, Dad.
嗨，爸爸。

60
00:03:20,839 --> 00:03:21,839
Am I interrupting you?
我打扰到你了吗？

61
00:03:22,759 --> 00:03:24,079
No, no, no, no.
没有，没有，没有，没有。

62
00:03:24,479 --> 00:03:24,919
What's up?
怎么了？

63
00:03:25,239 --> 00:03:25,919
Can we talk?
我们能谈谈吗？

64
00:03:27,119 --> 00:03:27,438
Sure.
当然。

65
00:03:28,719 --> 00:03:29,879
I need some help.
我需要一些帮助。

66
00:03:31,639 --> 00:03:33,318
Well, that's what fathers are for.
这就是父亲存在的意义。

67
00:03:33,799 --> 00:03:36,123
Well, before I go to college, I have the whole summer.
在我上大学之前，整个夏天都是我的时间。

68
00:03:37,204 --> 00:03:37,524
Yes.
是的。

69
00:03:38,124 --> 00:03:40,403
And I'm planning to get a job for the summer.
我打算在夏天找份工作。

70
00:03:41,724 --> 00:03:43,244
And what sort of job?
什么样的工作？

71
00:03:43,844 --> 00:03:46,524
I applied for a job as a lifeguard at the community pool.
我申请了社区游泳池的救生员职位。

72
00:03:47,884 --> 00:03:48,964
Sounds pretty good.
听起来不错。

73
00:03:49,644 --> 00:03:52,384
Yes, I'll be earning pretty good money if I get it,
是的，如果我得到这份工作，我会赚不少钱，

74
00:03:53,204 --> 00:03:55,404
but right now I'm kind of short of cash.
但现在我手头有点紧。

75
00:03:58,044 --> 00:03:58,589
Who is it?
是谁？

76
00:03:59,209 --> 00:04:02,089
And my friend Alexander is going back to Greece.
我的朋友亚历山大要回希腊了。

77
00:04:03,049 --> 00:04:03,969
Nice girl.
好女孩。

78
00:04:04,809 --> 00:04:05,768
We'll all miss her.
我们都会想念她的。

79
00:04:06,169 --> 00:04:08,569
Mom says we can give her a going away surprise party.
妈妈说我们可以为她举办一个惊喜告别派对。

80
00:04:09,729 --> 00:04:10,409
Good idea.
好主意。

81
00:04:11,169 --> 00:04:12,808
And I'd like to get her a nice gift.
我想送她一份精美的礼物。

82
00:04:14,809 --> 00:04:15,689
What'd you have in mind?
你有什么想法？

83
00:04:16,769 --> 00:04:21,729
Well, a wristwatch, so she'll think of me when she looks at the time.
一块手表，这样她看时间时就会想起我。

84
00:04:22,814 --> 00:04:26,093
Nothing flashy or expensive, something simple,
不要花哨或昂贵的，简单一点的，

85
00:04:26,254 --> 00:04:27,014
but a good one.
但质量要好。

86
00:04:28,614 --> 00:04:29,694
Sounds fine, Robbie.
听起来不错，罗比。

87
00:04:30,534 --> 00:04:34,133
Well, I saw a nice watch, but I'll need a loan.
我看到了一块不错的手表，但我需要借点钱。

88
00:04:34,894 --> 00:04:38,293
If you could lend me the money, I could pay you back out of my lifeguard salary.
如果你能借给我钱，我可以从救生员的工资里还给你。

89
00:04:40,174 --> 00:04:45,293
Well, uh, I guess your mother and I can manage
嗯，我想你妈妈和我可以

90
00:04:45,334 --> 00:04:45,634
it.
办到。

91
00:04:47,219 --> 00:04:48,059
when do you need the money?
你什么时候需要钱？

92
00:04:48,899 --> 00:04:49,979
Would tomorrow be okay?
明天可以吗？

93
00:04:52,699 --> 00:04:53,379
You've got it.
没问题。

94
00:04:54,979 --> 00:04:55,779
Thanks, Dad.
谢谢，爸爸。

95
00:04:56,859 --> 00:04:57,659
My pleasure, son.
不客气，儿子。

96
00:04:59,339 --> 00:05:00,298
Oh, and Robbie.
哦，还有罗比。

97
00:05:01,499 --> 00:05:01,818
Yes?
什么事？

98
00:05:02,819 --> 00:05:07,778
You'll probably want the family car so you can drive her home after the party.
你可能想要家里的车，这样派对后你可以开车送她回家。

99
00:05:08,459 --> 00:05:09,019
Could I?
我可以吗？

100
00:05:14,864 --> 00:05:16,463
If you drive carefully.
如果你小心驾驶的话。

101
00:05:17,264 --> 00:05:17,743
I will.
我会的。

102
00:05:18,184 --> 00:05:18,824
Thanks, Dad.
谢谢爸爸。

103
00:05:19,344 --> 00:05:19,944
My pleasure.
不客气。

104
00:05:21,744 --> 00:05:22,783
You're okay, Dad.
你真好，爸爸。

105
00:05:25,384 --> 00:05:27,263
You're not so bad yourself, son.
你也挺不错的，儿子。

1
00:00:20,550 --> 00:00:22,250
You ready for the next problem?
你准备好做下一道题了吗？

2
00:00:23,390 --> 00:00:26,130
You know what?I can't look at another number.
你知道吗？我再也看不了数字了。

3
00:00:26,230 --> 00:00:27,850
How about a lemonade break?
来杯柠檬水休息一下怎么样？

4
00:00:27,950 --> 00:00:29,150
Sure.
好啊。

5
00:00:33,150 --> 00:00:34,570
Oh,by the way,
哦，对了，

6
00:00:34,670 --> 00:00:37,670
when is your plane reservation for your flight to Athens?
你去雅典的航班预订是什么时候？

7
00:00:37,770 --> 00:00:39,010
Sunday,why?
周日，怎么了？

8
00:00:39,830 --> 00:00:42,250
Would you be able to come over Saturday night?
周六晚上你能过来吗？

9
00:00:43,710 --> 00:00:46,610
Yes,I should be finished packing by then.
可以，到时候我应该已经收拾好行李了。

10
00:00:47,190 --> 00:00:50,210
My folks are giving me a little graduation party.
我父母要为我办一个小型毕业派对。

11
00:00:50,350 --> 00:00:51,570
Terrific.
太棒了。

12
00:00:51,670 --> 00:00:52,870
I'll pick you up.
我去接你。

13
00:00:53,230 --> 00:00:54,810
That isn't necessary.
没必要。

14
00:00:54,910 --> 00:00:56,970
My dad's letting me borrow the car.
我爸让我借他的车用。

15
00:00:57,230 --> 00:01:00,650
Oh,well,that would be very nice.
哦，那太好了。

16
00:01:00,750 --> 00:01:02,090
About 8 o'clock?
八点左右？

17
00:01:02,350 --> 00:01:03,770
8 o'clock is fine.
八点没问题。

18
00:01:03,870 --> 00:01:05,290
Great,it's a date.
太好了，就这么定了。

19
00:01:06,030 --> 00:01:07,410
Who's gonna be there?
都会有谁在？

20
00:01:08,990 --> 00:01:11,770
Just my friend Mike and a few kids from school.
就我的朋友迈克和几个学校里的同学。

21
00:01:12,910 --> 00:01:14,650
I'm gonna miss all of you.
我会想念你们所有人的。

22
00:01:15,310 --> 00:01:17,570
You've been like a second family to me.
你们对我来说就像第二个家庭一样。

23
00:01:18,310 --> 00:01:19,850
We're going to miss you.
我们会想你的。

24
00:01:20,270 --> 00:01:22,390
Maybe you could come to visit me in Greece.
也许你可以来希腊看我。

25
00:01:22,490 --> 00:01:23,690
I'm counting on it.
我指望这个呢。

26
00:01:23,790 --> 00:01:27,810
Wonderful.Are you excited about graduating from high school?
太好了。你对高中毕业感到兴奋吗？

27
00:01:27,910 --> 00:01:30,970
Sure.And a little scared.
当然，也有点害怕。

28
00:01:31,710 --> 00:01:32,990
Scared?Why?
害怕？为什么？

29
00:01:33,090 --> 00:01:34,690
Aren't you a little scared?
你不也有一点害怕吗？

30
00:01:36,790 --> 00:01:39,650
I was when I first came to the United States.
我刚来美国的时候就很害怕。

31
00:01:40,070 --> 00:01:42,050
I'd never been away from home,
我以前从没离开过家，

32
00:01:42,150 --> 00:01:44,170
and I didn't know what it would be like.
也不知道会是什么样子。

33
00:01:45,470 --> 00:01:48,640
But then I found out that people are the
但后来我发现，一旦你了解人们，

34
